(2) A young girl with two pigtails wearing a grey t-shirt and tan shorts approaches the green package. A pair of adult hands enters the frame to help peel off the green plastic wrapping. (3) The girl is seen carrying a large, rolled-up white mat with colorful dots across the room. She moves toward a wooden bookshelf filled with children's books. The environment is clean and tidy. (4) The girl sits down on a round, grey tufted cushion placed on the floor. An adult hand presents her with a large, orange, flower-shaped plush pillow. The girl looks at it with a curious expression. (5) The girl carries the large orange flower plushie and another white egg-shaped plushie in her arms. She walks across the room, demonstrating her strength as she maneuvers through the living space. (6) The girl sits on the grey cushion near a wooden bookshelf and picks up a large picture book. She holds it carefully and prepares to read, her facial expression showing concentration. (7) The girl sits with her back against a large, white, cloud-shaped backrest cushion. She leans back and relaxes, looking directly at the camera with a satisfied smile. (8) Two young girls and an orange cat are seen lying together on a white mat on the floor, surrounded by various plush cushions. The cat is resting calmly between them. (9) The final scene transitions to a pink screen with a cartoon illustration of the girl and the text 'POPO'S DAILY LIFE'.
